author: @FrankCurzio
text:
Anthropic's IPO was a gift to the people selling it.

Anthropic ($ANT) just broke below its $83 IPO price, falling as low as $78 on Tuesday. That's day four. It opened at $111.50 on Nov 19.

SpaceX took about a month to fall under its offer. The biggest IPO in history did it in four sessions.

Roughly half the big funds that ordered shares got nothing... so they chased it on the open. Now every one of those buyers who sells adds more supply.

And the insiders already cashed out at $83. Dario Amodei sold 3,378,378 shares to the underwriters, more than $280M. Daniela Amodei sold the same number (great timing).

Day-one buyers at $111 are down about 30%.

I said last week I'd wait on this one. The lockups free up a big chunk of stock through February, and that selling hasn't even started.

Amazon ($AMZN) gets paid on Anthropic's cloud bill wherever the stock trades. That's still the cleaner way for me to own this.

-

For anyone new here, I'm Frank. 30 years on Wall Street, and I post what's moving the market as it happens. Follow me @FrankCurzio for more.
